title: Amtrak PIDS closeout remains held after the Phase 57Z exact-evidence recheck
summary: Amtrak's June 2026 ADA report records 93 PIDS deployments and marks the program period complete, but it also describes FRA closeout as pending review; it does not supply a final FRA closeout artifact. Decision: hold not resolved.
